name: Speed Duel: Attack from the Deep Booster Box
cleanName: Speed Duel Attack from the Deep Booster Box
extDescription: Each booster box contains 36 packs of 4 random cards.

name: Speed Duel: Attack from the Deep Booster Pack
cleanName: Speed Duel Attack from the Deep Booster Pack
extDescription: Each booster pack contains 4 random cards.

name: Magician of Faith
extDescription: FLIP: Target 1 Spell in your GY; add that target to your hand.

name: Apprentice Magician
extDescription: If this card is Summoned: Target 1 face-up card on the field that you can place a Spell Counter on; place 1 Spell Counter on that target. If this card is destroyed by battle: You can Special Summon 1 Level 2 or lower Spellcaster monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

name: Mystical Elf
extDescription: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

name: Magical Undertaker
extDescription: FLIP: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower Spellcaster monster in your GY; Special Summon that target.

name: Arcane Barrier
extDescription: Each time a face-up Spellcaster monster(s) on the field is destroyed, place 1 Spell Counter on this card (max. 4). You can send this card and 1 face-up Spellcaster monster you control to the GY; draw 1 card for each Spell Counter that was on this card.

name: Blade Knight
extDescription: Gains 400 ATK while you have 1 or less cards in your hand. If you control no other monsters, the effects of Flip monsters destroyed by battle with this card are negated.

name: Dweller in the Depths
extDescription: Gains 300 ATK for each Continuous Spell in your Spell & Trap Zone.

name: Gilford the Lightning
extDescription: You can Tribute 3 monsters to Tribute Summon (but not Set) this card. If Summoned this way: Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.

name: Axe Raider
extDescription: An axe-wielding monster of tremendous strength and agility.

name: Fusion Recovery
extDescription: Target 1 "Polymerization" in your GY, and 1 monster in your GY that was used as material for a Fusion Summon; add them to your hand.

name: Sonic Bird
extDescription: When this card is Normal or Flip Summoned: You can add 1 Ritual Spell from your Deck to your hand.

name: Great Phantom Thief
extDescription: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Declare 1 card name; look at your opponent's hand, and if you do, discard all cards with that name in their hand.

name: Djinn Disserere of Rituals
extDescription: When you Ritual Summon a monster, you can banish this card from your GY as 1 of the monsters required for the Ritual Summon. The monster Ritual Summoned using this card is unaffected by Trap effects.

name: Fulfillment of the Contract
extDescription: Activate this card by paying 800 LP, then target 1 Ritual Monster in your GY; Special Summon it and equip it with this card. When this card is destroyed, banish the equipped monster.

name: Amazoness Trainee
extDescription: Monsters destroyed by battle with this card are returned to the bottom of the Deck instead of going to the GY. If this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: It gains 200 ATK.

name: Robbin' Zombie
extDescription: If your monster inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY.

name: Zombina
extDescription: If this card in its owner's possession is destroyed by an opponent's card: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower monster in your GY, except "Zombina"; Special Summon it.

name: Goblin Zombie
extDescription: If this card inflicts battle damage to your opponent: Send the top card of their Deck to the GY. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: Add 1 Zombie monster with 1200 or less DEF from your Deck to your hand.

name: Sword of Dark Destruction
extDescription: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK and loses 200 DEF.

name: Pyramid of Wonders
extDescription: All Zombie monsters you control gain 200 ATK for each monster your opponent controls. If exactly 1 Zombie monster you control (and no other cards) would be destroyed, you can send this card to the GY instead.

name: Great White
extDescription: A giant white shark with razor-sharp teeth.

name: High Tide Gyojin
extDescription: A very agile half-fish warrior known for its relentless attacks.

name: The Legendary Fisherman
extDescription: While "Umi" is on the field, this card is unaffected by Spell effects and cannot be targeted for attacks, but does not prevent your opponent from attacking you directly.

name: Yomi Ship
extDescription: If this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the GY: Destroy the monster that destroyed this card.

name: Levia-Dragon - Daedalus
extDescription: You can send 1 face-up "Umi" you control to the GY; destroy all other cards on the field.

name: Lost Blue Breaker
extDescription: If there is another face-up Fish, Sea Serpent, or Aqua monster on the field: You can Tribute this card, then target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

name: Fishborg Planter
extDescription: Once, while this card is in the GY: You can send the top card of your Deck to the GY, then, if it is a WATER monster, Special Summon this card from the GY. You can only use this effect of "Fishborg Planter" once per turn.

name: Imairuka
extDescription: If this card you control is destroyed by your opponent's card and sent to your GY: Send the top card of your Deck to the GY, then, if it is a WATER monster, draw 1 card.

name: Slushy
extDescription: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can send 1 "Slushy" from your Deck to the GY. If you have 3 copies of "Slushy" total, either banished and/or in your GY (combined): You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 Level 5 or higher Sea Serpent monster in your GY; Special Summon that target. You can only use this effect of "Slushy" once per turn.

name: Power of Kaishin
extDescription: Equip only to an Aqua monster. It gains 300 ATK/DEF.

name: Umi
extDescription: All Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, and Aqua monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, also all Machine and Pyro monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

name: Big Wave Small Wave
extDescription: Destroy all face-up WATER monsters you control, then you can Special Summon WATER monsters from your hand, up to the number of monsters destroyed by this effect.

name: Water Hazard
extDescription: Once per turn: You can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster from your hand. You must control no monsters to activate and to resolve this effect.

name: Moray of Greed
extDescription: Shuffle 2 WATER monsters from your hand into the Deck, then draw 3 cards.

name: Warrior Dai Grepher
extDescription: The warrior who can manipulate dragons. Nobody knows his mysterious past.

name: Sonic Duck
extDescription: A duck which can walk at a sonic speed. Sometimes, he cannot deal with his incredible pace and loses control.

name: Sinister Serpent
extDescription: During your Standby Phase, if this card is in your GY: You can add it to your hand, also banish 1 "Sinister Serpent" from your GY during your opponent's next End Phase. You can only use this effect of "Sinister Serpent" once per turn.

name: Theban Nightmare
extDescription: Gains 1500 ATK while you have no cards in your hand nor in your Spell & Trap Zones.

name: Infernity Beast
extDescription: If this card attacks while you have no cards in your hand, your opponent cannot activate any Spell or Trap Cards until after the Damage Step.

name: Ryu Senshi
extDescription:
"Warrior Dai Grepher" + "Spirit Ryu"
A Fusion Summon of this card can only be done with the above Fusion Materials. When a Normal Trap Card is activated (Quick Effect): You can pay 1000 LP; negate that effect. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect. Negate the effects of any Spell Card that targets this card and destroy it.

name: Warrior Elimination
extDescription: Destroy all Warrior monsters on the field.

name: Mask of the Accursed
extDescription: The equipped monster cannot attack. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase: Inflict 500 damage to the controller of the equipped monster.

name: Dust Tornado
extDescription: Target 1 Spell/Trap your opponent controls; destroy that target, then you can Set 1 Spell/Trap from your hand.

name: Ready for Intercepting
extDescription: Target 1 Warrior or Spellcaster monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

name: The Forceful Checkpoint
extDescription: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Look at your opponent's hand, and if there is a Monster Card, negate the attack, then discard 1 monster from their hand (your choice).

name: The World's Greatest Fisherman
extDescription: Once per turn, you can pay 500 LP and discard 1 WATER monster, then add 1 WATER monster from your GY to your hand, with a different name and with a Level no more than twice the discarded monster's Level. If you do that, flip this card over.

name: Mythic Depths
extDescription: All Fish, Sea Serpent, Thunder, and Aqua monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF. All Machine and Pyro monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF. This card's name becomes "Umi" while on the field.

name: Catch of the Day
extDescription:
If you control "The Legendary Fisherman", you can activate "Umi" directly from your Deck or GY. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.
Once per turn, when "The Legendary Fisherman" you control destroys a monster by battle or inflicts battle damage to your opponent, you can Special Summon 1 Level 4 or lower WATER monster from your Deck or GY in Defense Position.

name: It's My Lucky Day!
extDescription: When you activate an effect that would make you roll a six-sided die (or dice) or flip a coin(s), you can pay 1000 LP to decide the result of 1 die or coin. This Skill can only be used once per Duel.

name: Viral Infection
extDescription: Once per turn, discard any number of cards and declare 1 type of card (Monster, Spell, or Trap). Your opponent sends 1 card of the declared type from their Deck to the GY for each discarded card. If you do that, flip this card over.
